# Earthens

> Earthens makes premium, 100% natural Areca palm leaf plates, bowls and party packs in Tumkur, Karnataka. Compostable, chemical-free tableware, exported worldwide.

## Key facts
- What: premium single-use tableware pressed from naturally fallen Areca palm leaf sheaths. No pulp, starch, glue, chemicals or coatings.
- Properties: 100% natural, compostable and biodegradable, microwave and oven safe, natural beige colour.
- Where: 39C-2, Hirehalli Industrial Area, Manchakalkuppe, Hirehalli, Tumkur, Karnataka 572168, India.
- Founded: idea in 2012 by siblings-in-law Ashima and Nilesh; manufacturing unit in Tumkur since 2016.
- People: 48 women artisans from nearby villages; team of 51-100. CEO: Ms. Dipti Goyal.
- Markets: worldwide, including Europe and the US. Exports by Engee Incorporated.
- Consumer product: EcoBhoj Party Pack, complete tableware for 15 guests (round or square), MRP ₹1,500 inclusive of taxes.

## Product range
- Plates: 10 inch Round Plate; 7 inch Round Plate; 10 inch Square Plate; 7 inch Square Plate; 10 inch Deep Square Plate; 4.5 inch Square Plate
- Bowls: 4.5 inch Round Curry Bowl; 3.5 inch Round Dessert Bowl; 8 inch Deep Round Bowl; 4 inch Square Curry Bowl; 3 inch Square Dessert Bowl; 7 inch Deep Square Bowl; Rectangular Bowl
- Cutlery: Areca Spoon; Teardrop Areca Spoon
- Trays: Serving Tray; 3 Compartment Round Plate; 4 Compartment Square Plate
- EcoBhoj: EcoBhoj Party Pack (Round); EcoBhoj Party Pack (Square)
